verdictBasis: The §6 gate passed and the paid run started legitimately. Harness defect HD-1 then made the §7 in-run guard stricter than the §4 frozen estimator by adding a per-shard Pass B term the methodology does not contain, inflating conservative-remaining to $16.6405 against the gate's own $15.8309. The guard therefore refused the first Pass A call of both passes, and the run continued with no semantic inventory, which voids it as a §8/§9 validation. $3.5017 is spent, leaving $12.3383 of the $15.84 cap. A complete fresh valid run costs $15.8309 conservative under the unchanged methodology, which exceeds the remaining cap, so §7 forbids proceeding: "Proceed only if remaining required work fits BOTH remaining cap and remaining gateway balance." Substituting mean x 1.25 ($10.3857, which would fit) is exactly the estimator substitution §6 prohibits. All completed outputs are preserved.

rootCause.statement: scripts/phase-3-601-funded-run.ts Guard.conservativeRemaining() priced Pass B as max(tokens x worstTokenRate, shards x worstSingleShardUsd). The §4 methodology prices Pass B solely per planner-estimated input token. The extra term added $0.647, and the guard and the gate disagreed.

nextStep: a new pre-registered mission with a cap that again covers the full $15.8309 conservative estimate. The harness defect is fixed and the frozen identities, plan and cost tiers all reproduced exactly, so that mission should reach a real Pass A on its first attempt.
